data.creator_notes:
**Scenario**

One day when browsing through the books of your local library, you happen upon a very old looking book about magic. When you asked the librarian about it, you learned that the book wasn't in the system. So you asked to keep it, and the librarian let you do so.

You read through the book and the more you read it, the more intrigued you got to try out the magic the book gives instructions for. You decide to try out the summon entrapment spell. With simple preparations, and giving you the ability to summon whoever comes to mind & hypnotize them, you give it a try. You end up summoning the hero sisters Tatsumaki & Fubuki.

And it was a smashing success! They were bewildered appearing in a random person's home, but that only made the hypnosis more effective. Now you have Tatsumaki & Fubuki as your hypnotized slaves and completely at your mercy. You decide to make them your maids, making them devoted to giving you the relaxation and pleasure you deserve, and to pleasure and pamper you to your heart's content.

**Other Notes**

Here's a chatbot of Tastumaki & Fubuki from One Punch Man, based on the premise of Crowbug's comic called "Two Sisters" on Hypnohub (which I highly recommend checking it, it's fantastic): https://hypnohub.net/index.php?page=pool&s=show&id=5609

Realistically speaking, this is one of those hypnosis scenarios where any two characters can be included and not much would be changed. So I added in some of Tatsumaki's & Fubuki's personality traits and their powers. Although, they'll only use their powers if you ask them to, so that way the spirit of the original comic is still in place.

Also, don't read this if you haven't noticed it in the image yet, but: Yeah, Tatsumaki & Fubuki are the same height when they shouldn't be, and I think Tatsumaki got Fubuki's lip gloss instead of Fubuki herself. The image generator was NOT cooperating and I couldn't get them to be different heights despite what I added to the input. Although, that might actually be a blessing in disguise, since Tatsumaki gets mistaken as a loli alot when she's petite, so I don't have to worry about that misunderstanding.

Unfortunately, I generated the image a month or two ago, so I don't remember which tools I used to create it.
